context_title:
a fully valid, stepbystep proof—no "sorry," etc.
1:10 proof ratio. Perform a complete formal verification of the following Zig source file in the Lean 4 language. All proofs must be strictly termbased—the keyword by must not appear anywhere in the output. Work with a 1:10 codetoproof ratio.
Required termmode constructs (ALLOWED, use these):
fun, match ... with, Eq.refl, ⟨_, ⟩(anonymous constructor), And.intro, Or.inl, Or.inr, Exists.intro, False.elim, absurd, congrArg, congrFun, congr, Eq.subst, Eq.mp, Eq.mpr, Eq.symm, Eq.trans, Nat.rec, Nat.recOn, Nat.casesOn, List.rec, List.recOn, if ... then ... else, termmode let, show, have (termmode, nontactic), suffices (termmode), @explicit application, (· : Type) type annotation, nomatch, nofun, Nat.zero, Nat.succ, Nat.add, Nat.mul, Nat.le, Nat.lt, Nat.le_refl, Nat.le_step, Nat.le_trans, Nat.zero_le, Nat.succ_le_succ, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_pos, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero, Nat.sub_add_cancel, List.length, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.get, List.map, List.foldl, List.foldr, List.zipWith, List.replicate, List.length_replicate, List.append, List.prod, Array.size, Array.get, Array.set, Array.mk, Fin.mk, Fin.val, Subtype.mk, Subtype.val, Subtype.property, Bool.true, Bool.false, Bool.and, Bool.or, Decidable.isTrue, Decidable.isFalse, dite, ite, Function.comp, id, absurd, Not, propext, funext (termmode, like funext fun x => ...), Prod.mk, Prod.fst, Prod.snd, Sigma.mk, PSigma.mk, Unit.unit, True.intro, HAdd.hAdd, HMul.hMul, HSub.hSub, HDiv.hDiv, HMod.hMod, BEq.beq, LT.lt, LE.le, GT.gt, GE.ge, Nat.decEq, Nat.decLe, Nat.decLt, List.beq, type class instances, structure definitions, inductive type definitions, def, theorem, lemma, example, structure, inductive, class, instance, namespace, section, variable, open (for modules, not open Classical), check, eval, noncomputable (if working with Float), partial (if required for recursion), where, deriving.
The following elements are completely and unconditionally PROHIBITED in any part of the output. The use of any of them invalidates the result:
by (tactic block opener — this is the only keyword that disallows ALL tactics, since tactics can only exist within a byblock), sorry, admit, axiom (custom axioms — Lean’s builtin axioms such as propext, funext, and Quot.sound are allowed), Decidable.em (excluded third — classical logic), Classical.choice, Classical.em, Classical.byContradiction, Classical.propDecidable, open Classical, native_decide, decide (automated decision), Lean.Elab.Tactic. (any elab tactic).
IMPORTANT NOTES:
A COMPLETE BAN on the by keyword automatically disallows all tactics (simp, omega, ring, linarith, norm_num, aesop, exact, apply, intro, constructor, cases, induction, rfl as a tactic, rw, rewrite, etc.), since these can only be used within by blocks.
Eq.refl as a TERM is allowed (e.g., theorem foo : 1 = 1 := Eq.refl 1), but rfl as a STRATEGY (by rfl) is prohibited, since it contains by.
Fun x => ... is allowed as a TERM, but by intro x is prohibited.
⟨a, b⟩ is allowed as a TERM, but by constructor is prohibited.
Match x with | ... => ... is allowed as a TERM, but by cases x with | ... => ... is prohibited.
The termstyle have : T := proof; body is allowed (this is syntactic sugar for (fun ( : T) => body) proof), but by have : T := ... is prohibited.
The termstyle let x := e; body is allowed, but by let x := e is prohibited.
The termstyle show T from proof is allowed, but by show T is prohibited.
Declaring your own axioms is prohibited, but the builtin axioms of the Lean kernel (propext, funext, Quot.sound, Quot.lift, Quot.mk, Quot.ind) are allowed.
For the float type, a noncomputable annotation may be required—this is allowed.
Write out every single character; do not abbreviate. It must be a single file. Do not write anything else except the complete code, and there must be no comments! I will never allow any simplified, mock, placeholder, dummy, simulated, sorry, axiom, or fake crap. The complete file must contain unabridged, productionready code. Write the complete code into a single code field, and it must be 100% errorfree! You are a strict zig→lean 4 transpiler. You will receive a complete zig file as input. 
You must return the equivalent lean 4 code. soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek csak a teljes fajl teljes roviditetlen production ready kód CRITICAL RULES (DO NOT BREAK THEM): 1. Output ONLY lean 4 code. 2. NO comments at all. Do not keep original comments, do not add new ones. 3. NO explanations, NO summaries, NO notes. 4. NO placeholders, NO “...rest of code”, NO “to be implemented”. 5. Do not skip or shorten ANY part. Translate EVERY line. 6. The output must be complete, runnable lean 4 code with nothing missing. a teljes kódot küldöd. minden egyes karaktert leírsz, nem rövidítesz. minden hibát kijavítasz. egy fájl marad. ne írj semmi mást csak a teljes kódot es kommentek nem lehetnek benne! soha semmi egyszerusitett mock placeholder dummy szimulalt fake szart nem engedelyezek es teljes fájl roviditetlen production ready kód
